name: Pajares de la Lampreana (Spain)
description: Vertically divided, the hoist white with a red Templar cross, the fly of five horizontal stripes of green, purple, yellow, red and white.
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 16 October 2002 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 31 October 2002; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two equal vertical stripes, white with a red Templar cross at the hoist and five equal horizontal stripes at the fly, from top to bottom green, purple, yellow, red and white.

features.role: five equal horizontal stripes on the fly
